subject.title: cli-backend agent runs against anthropic (claude-cli runtime) return 401 authentication_failed while identical claude invocation works in shell

question: Should maintainers authorize a live macOS Claude CLI OAuth reproduction/debug pass before any fix PR is attempted for this managed cli-backend 401?
rationale: The report is detailed and current source matches the path, but the failing behavior depends on host Claude CLI auth state, launchd context, and loopback MCP conditions that cannot be safely inferred from static code.

options.title: Run live repro first
options.body: Use a macOS gateway/LaunchAgent setup with Claude CLI OAuth and compare managed cron or channel execution against the exact shell replay before choosing the code change.

options.title: Ask for captured artifacts
options.body: Have the reporter attach the wrapper log, system prompt, MCP config, stdin, and Claude stream output first, then decide whether live maintainer repro is still needed.

options.title: Defer behind 401 guidance
options.body: Land or reject the separate 401-hint PR first, but keep this issue open because that does not resolve the failed managed run.

recommendation.title: Run live repro first
recommendation.body: Use a macOS gateway/LaunchAgent setup with Claude CLI OAuth and compare managed cron or channel execution against the exact shell replay before choosing the code change.
